Metadata.title: Strate, sovereign memory-base infrastructure
Metadata.description: Choose, deploy and run your sovereign AI memory base — no migration, no lock-in, no hidden costs.

hero.title: Your organization's knowledge should <mark>never</mark> leave your walls.
hero.subtitle: Strate turns your documents, decisions and conversations into a queryable memory, hosted on your premises or in the EU — never with foreign giants. You keep everything. You depend on no one.
hero.trust: Hosted in EU / Morocco · CNDP & GDPR compliant · Zero lock-in — leave with everything, whenever you want

why.title: Four promises. Only one already proven, the others measured at your own site.
why.subtitle: We don't promise you the moon without proof. Here is what we stand for, and how honestly.

profits.title: ↑ More profit
profits.body: Better decisions, faster: your memory answers instead of sleeping in folders. The right knowledge, at the right time, to the right role.
profits.proof: To be measured at your site (before / after)

efficient.title: ↑ More efficient
efficient.body: No more hours lost hunting for «where is that document, who decided what». We give that time back to you.
efficient.proof: To be measured at your site (search time)

costs.title: ↓ Lower costs
costs.body: Right-sizing, sourced and dated prices, and the hunt for hidden overruns. Never a surprise bill.
costs.proof: Sourced cost map + continuous price watch

risks.title: ↓ Lower risk
risks.body: Zero lock-in (leave with your whole stack in one click), compliance by design, and the expertise that spares you the costly mistake.

difference.title: We tell you the truth, even when it stings.
difference.body: If an open-source solution is enough, we tell you. If only a paid tool will do, we tell you that too. If your constraints contradict each other (tight budget + maximum sovereignty), we point it out — we won't sell you the impossible. And we take no hidden commission from the vendors we recommend.
difference.link: Read the fiduciary charter — zero hidden commission

how.title: From pain to decision, in 90 seconds.

diagnostic.title: Free diagnostic
diagnostic.body: Tell us what hurts (in your own words or guided). We give you your risk, your gain and a firm price.

plan.title: Sourced & shareable plan
plan.body: A clear recommendation, every cost linked to its source, exportable and shareable with your leadership.

deploy.title: Agent-driven deployment
deploy.body: Our agents deploy and operate it, with no need for you to hire or relearn everything.

pricing.title: The diagnostic is free. You only pay for the cooking.
pricing.subtitle: Infrastructure cost stays transparent, paid to your own vendors — we take no markup on it.
pricing.note: Amounts will be set by the ongoing price survey (Van Westendorp + conjoint analysis), not picked out of thin air.

diagnostic.title: Your verdict in 90 seconds.
diagnostic.subtitle: Four questions. A quantified, sourced verdict: your risk, your gain, a firm price and the path forward.

ctaFinal.title: Your memory belongs to you. Take it back.
ctaFinal.body: Start with the free diagnostic. In 90 seconds you'll know your risk, your gain, and the path forward.
